UTUT106801248.method: Hand-estimated from the locator map in NPR's 2026-09-30 story. Anchored on the Carbon County-Price Regional Airport marker (39.6139, -110.7514) and the map's 3-mile scale bar; the hatched site's visual center falls about 3.0 mi east and 0.95 mi south of the airport. Not BLM geometry; the BLM case has no shape or legal land description yet.
UTUT106801248.description: Valar Atomics proposes a nuclear-powered data center campus on more than 9,000 acres of BLM land east of Price, Utah: roughly 456 small reactors producing about 9.6 GW, plus data centers, fuel production and waste storage. Non-nuclear construction could begin by the end of 2026, with the first reactors in 2028.
